text: The proposed motion responds to traffic and safety concerns raised by local constituents.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services, to investigate the feasibility of installing traffic calming measures on Rouge River Drive, between Sheppard Avenue East (west intersection) and Sheppard Avenue East / Dean Park Road (east intersection), and report back to Scarborough Community Council with the review of findings and recommendations in the third quarter of 2026.
